title: Chapter 497 - 497 Going Forward; A Stumbling Block To Learning!
content:
Chapter 497 - 497 Going Forward; A Stumbling Block To Learning!

Chapter 497 - 497 Going Forward; A Stumbling Block to Learning!

497 Going Forward; A Stumbling Block to Learning!

Lin Fan looked at the expectant faces of everyone and smiled. “Alright, then we can all go together.”

“Thank you, Professor Lin!” everyone shouted excitedly.

Since the start of the Fields Medal, it had only been awarded to a few dozen people.

None of them had ever thought of winning the award.

To them, being able to attend the award ceremony was already very special.

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s beautiful eyes flashed with a faint light.

However, they were not happy because they could go to the award ceremony.

They were happy because they would have more time to spend with Lin Fan.

…

Just as Hu Chuan had expected, it was rare for Jiangbei University to have a Fields Medal winner. This was a rare opportunity for publicity.

Almost as soon as he walked into the office, the phone in his pocket rang.

“Hu Chuan, I heard that Lin Fan from Jiangbei University’s math department won the Fields Medal. Congratulations…”

“What’s there to be happy about?” Hu Chuan asked. “This is Lin Fan’s honor, and he should be congratulated.

“However, Huaqing University and Capital University haven’t won the Fields Medal yet. This is the first Fields Medal from Hua Nation, right? I, Jiangbei University, and the mathematics department will benefit from it. Yes, we’ll just benefit from it…”

Although he said that he did not care, the smile on Hu Chuan’s face seemed to be saying that he should be congratulated!

…

On Weibo.

Almost at the same time as Hu Chuan told Lin Fan about the award…

Nation Daily: [Congratulations to Lin Fan of Jiangbei University for winning the Fields Medal.]

Rollie: [How many times has the Nation Daily congratulated Professor Lin? Professor Lin is awesome!]

Stone Golem: [The fewer words, the bigger the matter!]

Fireball: [Fields Medal! F*ck!]

Nobody: [So, what’s the Fields Medal? Can you give me a big explanation?]

Man-Eating Bug: [The Fields Medal seems to be a mathematics award.]

Shadowless Kick: [Isn’t it just a Fields Medal? It’s not like it’s a Nobel Prize. There’s no need to be so excited, right?]

Madman: [Don’t be excited? People often say that the average undergraduate acceptance rate is less than 3%, and I’ve seen it for myself now.

[Let me give everyone a brief introduction.

[There is no Nobel Prize in mathematics!

[The Fields Medal is the most prestigious award in the mathematics world, and it’s also known as the Nobel Prize in mathematics!

[In addition, Professor Lin is also the first person from Hua Nation to win the Fields Medal!]

Mr. Mo: [God Lin is awesome!]

Nine Heavens Essence: [God Lin is awesome!]

Silent Smile: [God Lin is awesome!]

…

Soon, the words ‘God Lin is awesome’ were pushed to the top of the trending searches.

Lin Fan did not care about any of this.

For the next few days, he went to school and Coiling Dragon Villa as usual.

Today, after eating breakfast, he drove the Cullinan straight to the airport.

That was because today was the day they were going to Barney.

When Lin Fan arrived at the airport, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Hao Zhiwu, and the others were already waiting there.

“Professor Lin!”

After greeting each other, everyone boarded the luxury plane of Xia Airlines under Lin Fan’s lead.

When Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Hao Zhiwu, and the others saw a row of beautiful air stewardesses lining up to welcome them and tasted the luxurious delicacies on the luxury plane…

They could not help but praise.

Liu Qianqian could not help but look at the tall and handsome Lin Fan.

He could play basketball, was handsome, and knowledgeable… Moreover, he was so rich!

He was simply a perfect male god!

No wonder even though Xia Bing and Xia Xue knew that Lin Fan had a girlfriend, they did not care.

At this moment, Lin Fan placed a plate of lobsters in front of Xia Bing and Xia Xue and said, “The lobsters taste good. Try them.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue were like children who had received a reward. Their faces were filled with happy smiles.

Seeing this…

Liu Qianqian could not help but look envious.

Even Liu Qianqian did not realize that she had strongly opposed it at the beginning but was slowly accepting it. Now, she was actually envious.

…

When they arrived at Barney, two Rolls-Royce were already waiting at the airport.

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Hao Zhiwu, and the others enjoyed the luxurious experience brought by Rolls-Royce. Their eyes kept looking at the unique buildings outside, and they sighed from time to time.

Soon, they arrived at Barney Shangri-La Hotel.

Barney Shangri-La Hotel had a different style compared to the Shangri-La in Hua Nation.

Most of the domestic styles were modern, while the ones here were European and American.

Unique statues, castle-like outer walls…

Under the lead of the attendant, Lin Fan, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, Hao Zhiwu, Liu Qianqian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others were brought to six luxurious presidential suites.

The reason why there were six rooms was because Xia Bing and Xia Xue wanted to stay together.

When one pulled open the curtains and looked out, one could see the tall and large Avenue de la Champs-Elysees.

After putting down their luggage, Lin Fan brought everyone to LAE, a Michelin 2-star restaurant.

Everyone ate the juicy foie gras, the beautiful M9 beef, and the crispy and delicious snacks…

After unloading their luggage and tasting the delicious food…

Lin Fan brought everyone to the spa.

Enjoying the soft massage, everyone almost cried out in pleasure.

“I’ll study harder when I get back!” Hao Zhiwu said immediately.

“You’re not gonna play with the gaming helmet anymore?” Jiang Chaoqun asked.

“What’s gaming? That’s just a stumbling block that’s stopping me from learning!” Hao Zhiwu said seriously.

“Why did you suddenly have such thoughts?” Nie Zhenjiang asked in confusion.

“Because only by studying hard can we have more opportunities to enjoy everything we had today!”

Lin Fan, who was walking in front, had a weird expression on his face when he heard Hao Zhiwu’s words.

He had brought him to eat, drink, and play, but it had aroused his desire to study hard?

The sky gradually darkened.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue sat quietly on the sofa. Their expressions were a little nervous, and their pretty faces were slightly red.

That was because Lin Fan stayed next door.

They were only separated by a wall!

The first time…

This was the first time that they were so close to Lin Fan.

They slowly raised their heads and looked at the wall.

Then, they quickly lowered their heads.

That appearance…

It was as if they were peeking at Lin Fan but were worried that they would be discovered.

At this time, a crisp doorbell suddenly rang in Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s presidential suite.
